text:
Sam: Heads-up — NovaRetail showing steady login volume but embeddings calls spiking errors, onboarding at 45%. Renewal in 21 days.
Riley: Error rate details?
Sam: 5xx on /embeddings endpoint, mostly timeouts after 10s. They use private deployment with a recent runtime patch.
Jo: I can triage infra but need logs/sample requests. Can we ask them to share the failing payloads?
Tariq: I'll offer a short "embedding health" clinic — 45min session for their ML lead. Could include quick batch-sizing tips and best-effort fixes.
Maya: Also propose a 7-day success sprint:
  - Day 0: concierge unblock call
  - Day 1-2: embedding clinic + dev hours
  - Day 4: adoption playbook review + exec sync
  - Day 7: 14-day health checkpoint with KPIs
Sam: Sounds good. If no improvement by day 10, propose a downgrade-mitigation path: temporary usage credit + scoped Dedicated trial to reduce latency.
Riley: Need approval for credits ahead of time. Finance sign-off required.
Maya: I'll draft a short email and the sprint checklist. We should reuse the "churn-save-sprint" template but keep it succinct.
cs-bot: Playbook "embedding-rescue-sprint-v2" found — https://redwood.tools/playbooks/embedding-rescue-sprint-v2 :link:
Jo: Sending log request template to Sam to forward. Also scheduling dev office hours: Thu 09:00-10:30 PT & Fri 15:00-16:00 PT.
Sam: Forwarded logs. Concierge call booked today 6pm PT.
Tariq: I'll lead the clinic Tue 11am PT. Will prepare a one-slide checklist: request sizes, batching, kv-cache hints, quantization note.
Maya: Draft email (short):
  "Hi <name>, noticed embedding errors and want to run a focused 7-day sprint to stabilize production. Can we confirm a concierge call today and an embedding clinic Tue 11am PT? We'll follow with office hours and a checkpoint. --Maya"
Sam: Edit: include "14-day checkpoint" line.
Maya: Updated and sent to <ops@novaretail.com>.
Riley: Finance approved up to 15% credit if errors persist and we confirm post-sprint KPIs.
Jo: Got the logs; initial hypothesis: large batched payloads causing mem pressure. Quick mitigation: reduce batch to 64 and enable streaming responses.
Tariq: I'll include a short code example in the clinic:
```
# reduce batch size + enable streaming
client.embed(batch_size=64, stream=True)
```
Maya: Ops checklist for thread:
  • Sam confirms concierge booked (done)
  • Jo posts mitigation steps in the customer doc
  • Tariq runs clinic and posts recording
  • Riley confirms promo terms in the thread
  • Maya runs exec sync and closes the sprint with KPIs
Sam: Thanks team — tracking here. Will update after clinic with any P0 items. :thumbsup:
